form.label: PulseForge — Security incident simulation
form.description: Inspect indexed synthetic incident observations; acceptance and simulated recovery are not indexing proof. Local indexed data only. Choose the configured event index and server-owned run ID. Remote destinations may have no data here. VERIFIED_HEALTHY is a simulated phase, not independent indexing verification.

search.query: search index=$index|s$ (sourcetype="netspout:network:syslog") netspout_run_id=$run_id|s$ | stats count as observed_records count(netspout_run_id) as present_netspout_run_id count(netspout_scenario_id) as present_netspout_scenario_id count(netspout_phase) as present_netspout_phase count(netspout_device_id) as present_netspout_device_id | eval data_status=case(observed_records=0,"MISSING_DATA",present_netspout_run_id=observed_records AND present_netspout_scenario_id=observed_records AND present_netspout_phase=observed_records AND present_netspout_device_id=observed_records,"FIELDS_PRESENT",1=1,"MISSING_FIELDS")
search index=$index|s$ (sourcetype="netspout:network:syslog") netspout_run_id=$run_id|s$ | stats count as observed_records by netspout_scenario_id netspout_phase netspout_device_id

search index=$index|s$ (sourcetype="netspout:network:syslog") netspout_run_id=$run_id|s$ | sort 0 _time | head 500 | table _time netspout_run_id netspout_scenario_id netspout_phase netspout_device_id _raw
